description: Cut the thread on her own arm and took the scissors back.

description: Spared a length and not the basket, and kept today's twopence unpaid.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Came for the Holinshed and was left to it.
name: Gib

description: Laid his hand flat on the bundle and did not open it again.
name: William Shakespeare
